label: TP
reason: User input retrieved via request.getParameter flows directly into an ArrayList, undergoes minimal modification (removal of a safe placeholder), and is subsequently written to the HTTP response body via response.getWriter() without any HTML entity encoding or sanitization, allowing potential XSS payloads to execute.

evidence.note: Param added to list alongside safe strings, safe strings removed, leaving param exposed at index 0.
Unsanitized variable bar containing user input is concatenated and written to response writer.
